Hi @lengyijun I think it would be easier to continue the conversation here. First, I'd like to say thanks for the attention to detail, stating things in a more general or clear way is always welcome. I see you've opened two new PRs though, which makes me think that this comment I left was unclear.

All of cslib#579, cslib#585, and cslib#586 are very similar in changing the signature of theorems from x ∉ M.fv → w ∉ N.fv to something like N.fv ⊆ M.fv or a statement about docs#Finset.erase. These seem like fine changes, but I have asked for them all in one PR so that I can:

  • easily check that this consistently changes all theorems rather than changing one at a time in different ways
  • check how these changing in tandem will affect any proofs using grind

I really do appreciate making small PRs, but in this case where these are related changes it is more helpful for me to see this in one PR since this remains a small diff.

https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/588#issuecomment-4539112952

I meet a problem of grind.
It is not related to fv-related theorems.
It's about the new added theorem: 

lemma subst_refl (m : Term Var) (x : Var) : m[x := fvar x] = m := by
  induction m <;> grind
I'm sorry, I'm not understanding your question. I don't see that lemma being added in your PR or what the problem with grind would be.
I will propose another pr to simplify close_open
I think close_open is too simple to appear in the code.
Oh, I think I see what you mean, because it is just a special case of close_open_to_subst plus your lemma above? That is reasonable.
